page.layout: One printed page of text, centred on the title page. Title lines in the upper and middle part, imprint and date in the lower part. Show-through from the reverse page is faint above the title and in the margins.
page.notes: Show-through from the reverse side is not transcribed: a mirrored heading above the title ("Argumentum Secundi Dialogi") and mirrored text in the margins and lower page. A faint mark "DI" in the left margin at mid-height, probably show-through or a signature, is not transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed on this page. The title is set in capitals with the printer's V forms, normalised to U/V by the rule for vowels; "VICI NA-/rum" is kept as a line-end hyphenated word.
